response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL)/SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(r.n) AS avg_tracks, AVG(r.rate - o.a) AS avg_margin FROM r, o WHERE r.rate > o.a
